review.notes: Full review of the repaired head. Sample: all 15 seeded targets read in AV-v1 at their locators, plus JRV Theorem 5.1 and Thom IV.13 (over 30 locators in all); journal data of the three references confirmed with publishers' records. Recomputed: the two genus-two Gaussian systems of 4.8 in exact arithmetic (characteristic polynomials, determinants 4/2 and 8/2, relator images, order of composition), closedness and symmetry of the boundary pairing of 0.3 on 21 complexes, the Zassenhaus Checks, the family example over Q[s]_(s), the density arithmetic of 6.3-6.4 and 7.1. Automatic checks all passed and none was set aside; dependency check 0 problems; elaboration gives sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes nothing. 14 supplier roadmaps and every cited section id resolved; acceptance is conditional on the 14 declared supplier gaps. One small correction (Dehn twists cited to GeometricTopology Layer 3 instead of Layer 1.7.2), one format note, one question for the author on the joint consequence of the sign laws of 2.5, 2.6 and 2.8 when the semicharacteristic is odd; ten source issues recorded.
